'''Greggo Brudd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who supported the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He worked for the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Rassan]].
